title: Mr. Ejoku Builds Houses
subtitle: Working Fathers of Soroti
author: Anthony Mwesigwa
description: Follow Mr. Ejoku as he builds strong homes for families in Soroti and the surrounding villages.
keywords: builder, construction, building, Uganda, Soroti, family, work, father, mason
dedication: For all the builders who create homes where families can live safely.
authorBio: Anthony Mwesigwa is a passionate storyteller from Kampala, Uganda, dedicated to creating engaging educational books for young African readers.
backCoverText: How are houses built? Join Mr. Ejoku as he lays bricks, mixes cement, and builds a home. A story about skill and perseverance.
